name: Labeling Others
overview: Scripture warns against the sin of labeling others with judgment and condemnation, emphasizing that we should not judge others harshly or hypocritically, as seen in Jesus' teaching to 'judge not, that ye be not judged' (Matthew 7:1) and the call to examine our own faults before criticizing others (Matthew 7:3). The Word also highlights the destructive power of careless speech and talebearing, which fuels strife and will be accounted for on the day of judgment (Proverbs 26:20; Matthew 12:36). Instead, believers are called to exercise righteous judgment that looks beyond appearances and to extend forgiveness, reflecting Christ's grace (John 7:24; Luke 6:37).
